dataset.name: St Petersburg INCART 12-lead Arrhythmia Database
dataset.description: 75 unseen 30-minute 12-lead Holter records with beat annotations. Lead II is used as the closest practical external counterpart to MLII.
dataset.warning: External validation: INCART lead II is not identical to MIT-BIH MLII, so results measure dataset, device, and lead-domain shift.

threshold_optimization.interpretation: Exploratory only: this threshold was selected and measured on the same requested labels. Use grouped validation for an unbiased research estimate.
